tickets.title: Prepare side-by-side care coverage comparison
tickets.text: Prepare a side-by-side comparison of in-home aide coverage, adult day programming, short-term respite stays, transportation options, and projected out-of-pocket costs for Harold Velvetreed and Lena Velvetreed, evaluating several weekly care-hour levels.
tickets.evidence: Harold asked for a side-by-side view of in-home aide coverage, adult day programming, short respite stays, transportation, and likely out-of-pocket costs under several weekly care-hour levels; the agreed follow-up is to prepare that comparison by 2026-01-20.

tickets.title: Build family caregiver coverage map
tickets.text: Build a caregiver coverage map for Harold Velvetreed and Lena Velvetreed that documents Sofia Copperwisp’s weekend availability, Martin Velvetreed’s remote medication support, and weekday evening gaps, aligning responsibilities with the couple’s mobility limits.
tickets.evidence: Lena’s mobility limits changed the household routine, and the family described Sofia’s weekend availability, Martin’s remote medication role, Harold’s fatigue, and gaps during weekday evenings; the agreed follow-up is to build a family caregiver coverage map by 2026-01-16.

tickets.title: Prepare Silver Marmot intake packet
tickets.text: Prepare an intake packet for the Silver Marmot Insurance claim appointment for Harold Velvetreed and Lena Velvetreed, including physician orders, care notes, aide agency estimates, invoices, and policy questions.
tickets.evidence: Silver Marmot Insurance has a claim-intake appointment pending, and the family needs an organized packet of physician orders, care notes, aide agency estimates, invoices, and policy questions for that conversation; the agreed follow-up is to prepare the intake packet by 2026-01-12.

tickets.title: Resolve aide shift minimum inconsistencies
tickets.text: Resolve the inconsistency in aide shift minimums for Harold Velvetreed and Lena Velvetreed by reconciling the agency’s four-hour daytime minimum with Sofia’s three-hour visit notes to ensure accurate weekly cost estimates.
tickets.evidence: One agency quote described a four-hour minimum for daytime shifts, while Sofia’s call notes showed three-hour visits, creating inconsistent assumptions in the projected weekly care cost; the agreed follow-up is to resolve the aide shift minimums in the cost estimates by 2026-01-13.

tickets.title: Correct secure upload access for Lena
tickets.text: Correct the secure upload access for Lena Velvetreed by reconfiguring the portal invitation so that her care records, health forms, and aide invoices are uploaded under her own login.
tickets.evidence: Lena’s portal invitation opened under Harold’s login, preventing a separate upload stream for care records, health forms, and aide invoices tied to Lena’s claim file; the agreed follow-up is to correct secure upload access by 2026-01-09.

tickets.title: Address policy benefit inflation assumptions
tickets.text: Address the differing inflation rider language in the two Silver Marmot Insurance policies for Harold Velvetreed and Lena Velvetreed to ensure daily benefit maximums are accurately reflected in care-cost projections.
tickets.evidence: Mira’s review found that the two Silver Marmot Insurance policies use different inflation rider language, which affects how the daily benefit maximums should be shown in the care-cost projections; the agreed follow-up is to address the policy benefit inflation assumptions by 2026-01-23.
